fusions.name: Subsonic Tremor
fusions.desc: Sounds a note too low to hear that shakes the ground, which deals 13 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stuns them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Beached Weight
fusions.desc: Throws your stranded bulk onto the target, which costs you 5% of your maximum health, deals 9 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Raised Seabed
fusions.desc: Raises a ridge of seabed 6 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Bones in the Chalk
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and your earth resistance rises by 8%.
